header.hash: FNV-1a 32 (offset 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193) over the little-endian float32 bytes of the MASTER output: per quantum the 128 left samples, then the 128 right samples; 8 hex digits. qh: the same per quantum, concatenated. head: first 16 samples per channel, float bits as hex.
header.output: the mixer strips summed (pure sources of a bus that has a node left out) x MASTER x OUT; no track effects, master effects, mastering, limiter or PDC. Only heard tracks have a chains node.
inputs: track t (0-based), sample index i from 0, channel L / R; all arithmetic IEEE double, ONE conversion to float32 at the end; no fused multiply-add, no fast-math

seeds: sL = ((uint32)(t + 1) * 2654435761u) ^ 0x2545F491u; sR = sL ^ 0xA5A5A5A5u; (0 -> 1). Per sample first advance BOTH: s ^= s << 13; s ^= s >> 17; s ^= s << 5 (uint32). uL = sL / 4294967296.0, uR = sR / 4294967296.0
burst = (((i >> 11) + t) & 3) == 0;  X = 0.25 * wave(p) + (burst ? 0.2 * (2.0 * u - 1.0) : 0.0)  (the addend 0.0 is always added); L uses (ph, uL), R uses (phR, uR); a MONO track has only L
header.song: each case embeds the song fragment it plays: bpm, lpb, ticks, master, mout, mix[32] {vol, trim, pan, mute, solo}, chainOn[32], chainPatch (as saved). The keep rule: heard = audible tracks that have an input, plus buses busStemPlan adds (index.html:25816-25820), then busClosure (25823-25827); a stem: heard = {stem} then busClosure.
header.nodes: one thunder-chains node per heard track with chainsFeed(t) (CHN on and the patch has a Chain Out for it), made in the order of `expect.nodes`: processorOptions {track, patch, quality full, transport {tempo bpm, lpb, ticks, playing false}, busMap = the plan feeds of that track (<= 32, ascending), tapMap []}; then every node gets the transport message {tempo bpm, lpb, ticks, playing true} before quantum 0 (it overrides the patch's saved transport).
header.events: ev.t in seconds (double). An event is applied at the START of quantum k (t <= 0: quantum 0). chc: k = ceil(ceil(t * 48000.0) / 128) in double (the Chrome-measured k-rate rule). tempo: k = ceil(t / q) with q = 128.0 / 48000.0 in double, and quantum 0 when ceil(t / q) * q is not inside (0, quanta * q). chc: node of ev.track (if it has one) parameter p = v (-1 own, 0 in, 1 bypassed, 2 flipped), held until changed. tempo: transport message {tempo: bpm, ticks: tks} to every node. expect.eventQuanta lists k per event.

cases.name: a/electro
cases.note: ELECTRO's own chains patch and bus plan: Track In 1, 2, 3, 7 into a Stereo mixer into Chain Out 4; tracks 4 (bus, own sound ignored: it has no Track In), 5 and 8 play straight to the master

cases.name: b/beta-testing-electro
cases.note: BETA-TESTING-ELECTRO's patch: Track In 1-6 and 9 into a Stereo mixer (7 inputs) into Chain Out 8; CHN on 1-6, 8, 9; track 7 plays straight

cases.name: c/bus-into-bus
cases.note: bus 3 (fed by 0, 1) feeds bus 5 (also fed by 2 with a PRE send): two nodes, the middle bus processed (fader, pan) before it is heard in bus 5; levels and pans differ on every input

cases.name: d/mono-into-bus
cases.note: two mono sources (panned off centre) into the bus, a mono track playing straight (the mono panner law) and a stereo source; the node hears a mono source as L = R

cases.name: e/mute-source
cases.note: track 2 (a source) muted: not kept, silent in the bus

cases.name: e/solo-source
cases.note: track 3 (a source) soloed: it and the bus (busAll) are heard, the other sources and the plain tracks are not

cases.name: e/mute-bus
cases.note: the bus track 4 muted: it is not kept, so it gets no node and its pure sources are NOT routed: they play straight to the master

cases.name: e/solo-bus
cases.note: the bus track 4 soloed: it and all its sources are heard (srcAll), nothing else

cases.name: f/byp-mid-quantum
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 at frame K*128 + 40 (inside quantum K): the page takes it from quantum K+1; b1 = -1 at frame 300*128 + 100 (from quantum 301)

cases.name: f/byp-on-quantum-start
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 at EXACTLY the first frame of quantum K (t = K*128/48000): ceil(t / q) = K, so it is seen in quantum K itself (t == t0 lands in the SAME block)

cases.name: f/byp-one-frame-before
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 one frame before quantum K (frame K*128 - 1): ceil gives K, quantum K

cases.name: f/byp-one-frame-after
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 one frame after the start of quantum K (frame K*128 + 1): ceil gives K+1

cases.name: f/byp-fuzz-quantum-start
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 at t = 190*128/48000, a quantum start whose ceil(t / q) is 191 in double arithmetic (ceil(t / q) gives the NEXT quantum, and Chrome's rule ceil(ceil(t * sr) / 128) gives it too for this k): C++ must use the chc rule of the header

cases.name: f/byp-chrome-rule-k5
cases.note: BYP b1 = 1 at EXACTLY 5*128/48000: Chrome (measured, chains-krate-check.mjs) sees it in quantum 5; the old expression ceil(t / q) gives 6 (the control)

cases.name: g/tempo-change
cases.note: a tempo-synced LFO in the chain; tempo 131 -> 97 at frame 120*128 + 77 (mid-quantum: from quantum 121) -> 140 at exactly frame 250*128 (a quantum start: quantum 250)

cases.name: h/stem-bus
cases.note: the stem of the bus track 4: keep = {3} + its audible sources (busClosure): the node is made, the sources feed it; the plain tracks are not heard

cases.name: h/stem-plain-track
cases.note: the stem of the plain track 5 (no chains): no node at all, only track 5 reaches the master

cases.name: h/stem-source-only
cases.note: a stem of the source track 1 alone (the page never asks: a track in its bus's stem has none; the rule is pinned anyway): the bus is not kept, so no node, and the source plays straight

cases.name: i/chain-off-bus-track
cases.note: CHN off on the bus track 4: no node, no bus, the sources play straight to the master

cases.name: i/no-chain-out
cases.note: CHN on for track 4 but the patch has no Chain Out for it (chainsFeed false): no node, no bus

cases.name: j/patch-transport-vs-song
cases.note: ELECTRO's patch (saved transport tempo 120, lpb 4) in the song at 131 / lpb 8, with a tempo-synced LFO: the song's transport must win (the control: without the page's initial transport message the hash differs)

cases.name: k/twenty-sources
cases.note: twenty sources into one bus (two Stereo mixers into one Chain Out): feed pairs 0..15 on input 4, 16..19 on input 5 (the second merger)

cases.name: l/chain-out-no-notes
cases.note: track 9 has CHN on, a Chain Out and an oscillator patched straight into it, but NO notes: the page keeps only tracks with notes (and the bus closure), so it gets no node and is SILENT; track 5 (with notes) plays. Control treatAsNotes: with track 9 treated as having notes the oscillator is heard
